policy: Posthoc source diagnostic at unchanged original discovery clock. Scene includes catalog T<=21 stars inside stamp plus one-pixel margin, deduplicated at .01pixel, with relative flux fixed from Tmag rather than independent free fluxes; hypotheses all included sources within3pixels of target. Linear TIC proper motions from J2000; no parallax. Out-of-event scene registers common shift; fixed registration for event/leave-one-out fits. No host probabilities.
